purpose: Recipe development policy for the fixed Sky130HD 100 MHz task. It preserves the registered clock and floorplan footprint.

early_place_timing_repair.rationale: Runs ORFS's documented placement-parasitic timing repair before CTS while preserving the registered 10 ns SDC, fixed floorplan footprint, routing layers, and complete strict-signoff check set.
early_place_timing_repair.promotion_scope: development only until two-family, two-trial strict A/B evidence exists

abc_overdrive_8ns.rationale: Uses a stricter 8 ns internal ABC mapping target while retaining the registered 10 ns SDC, fixed floorplan footprint, routing layers, and complete strict-signoff check set.
abc_overdrive_8ns.promotion_scope: development only until two-family, two-trial strict A/B evidence exists

abc_timing_mapping.rationale: Switches a baseline area-biased ABC mapping to ORFS's timing-driven ABC mapping while retaining the registered 10 ns SDC, fixed floorplan footprint, routing layers, and complete strict-signoff check set.
abc_timing_mapping.promotion_scope: development only until two-family, two-trial strict A/B evidence exists

hierarchical_synthesis_mapping.rationale: Enables ORFS hierarchical synthesis while retaining the registered 10 ns SDC, fixed floorplan footprint, baseline ABC objective, routing layers, source closure, and complete strict-signoff check set.
hierarchical_synthesis_mapping.promotion_scope: development only until two-family, two-trial strict A/B evidence exists
